top_apps.description_short: Immersive puzzle game
top_apps.description_excerpt:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

top_apps.description_excerpt:
🎯 Blast & Clear – Shoot, Smash, and Unwind! 🎯

If you're looking for a stress‑melting shooting game that still gives your brain a little workout, this is it. Grab your cannon, take aim, and fire away at a platform full of targets. 凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

top_apps.name: Chicken Road
top_apps.description_short: Chicken Road: Rule your kingdom with every swipe and decision
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Chicken Road is an offline kingdom simulation where every decision shapes the future of your realm. Rule as the monarch of Aldermere, listen to petitions from nobles, priests, generals, and villagers, then answer with a simple swipe left or right. Every choice changes the balance of your kingdom.

Manage four key resources: Faith, People, Military, and Gold. Let any of them fall too low—or rise too high—and your reign may come to an unexpected end. Decisions have lasting consequences, with events returning many turns later to reward or challenge your earlier choices. Every ruler eventually dies, but the dynasty continues as heirs inherit the kingdom you created.

Discover more than 70 unique petitions, 13 memorable court characters, multiple endings, a royal chronicle, a hall of kings, and 15 dynasty achievements. Your progress is saved automatically after every decision, allowing you to continue at any time. Chicken Road works completely offline, contains no ads, no in-app purchases, no registration, and stores all progress locally on your device.

top_apps.name: Anh Hai's Pho Restaurant
top_apps.description_short: A simulation story-driven horror restaurant game about Brother Hai and 6 endings
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Anh Hai’s Pho Restaurant is a dialogue-driven comedy game with a touch of horror, inspired by true events in Vietnam and developed using Godot Engine. The game offers a vivid and authentic portrayal of how Vietnam’s famous pho is prepared.

Play as Brother Hai (Anh 2), the owner of a pho restaurant on Thanh Binh Street. Every day, he serves pho to the local community. Thanh Binh Street may seem peaceful, but beneath its quiet appearance lies a dark secret. Brother Hai must face unexpected incidents and dangers he never imagined he would encounter. The game also tells a touching and deeply human story about the bond between Brother Hai and his dog, Mr Gold.

Features
- An engaging storyline
- A cinematic experience
- Realistic graphics
- A landscape with a strong Vietnamese character
- Various minigames, including motorcycle racing and escape sequences
- An authentic recreation of pho preparation, complete with side dishes such as fried dough sticks, fried rice, and poached eggs
- 6 different endings

Enjoy your pho, and thank you for always supporting us!
